$comment: Maps Stream Deck actions onto Microsoft Teams meeting controls.
Teams' local third-party API (ws://localhost:8124) was retired on 2026-06-30
with no replacement, so controls are driven through UI Automation instead.
AutomationIds below were read directly from the Teams meeting toolbar and are
locale-independent. The *Pattern fields match the button's accessible name,
which IS localised - translate those if you run Teams in another language.
A button's name describes the action it performs, so it is the inverse of the
current state: 'Unmute mic' means you are currently muted.
Edit this file and restart the plugin to re-map controls after a Teams update.
Use the Diagnostics panel in any action's property inspector to dump the live
UI tree into the plugin log.
